lines.text: Jesus finds a large crowd and scribes arguing with His disciples, and the people run to greet Him.
A father says his son has a mute spirit that throws him down, and the disciples were unable to drive it out.
The father says the spirit has been with his son from childhood and often throws him into the sea.

wrong_details.true: the fire or into the water

lines.text: Jesus commands the deaf and mute spirit to come out, and after it leaves, He takes the boy by the foot and lifts him.
In the house, the disciples ask why they could not drive it out, and Jesus says this kind comes out only by prayer.
